result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there is one notable navigation state bug and a few minor visual concerns around truncation and cropped carousel items.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active/highlighted tab (green icon and label), but the screen displayed is clearly the Home feed with delivery address, search, promos, and restaurant lists. The 'Home' tab should be active.
issues.suggestion: Fix the active tab state logic so the Home tab is highlighted when the home feed is displayed.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, making it look cut off rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add a text ellipsis (…) for truncated names or constrain the label width to the card so truncation appears intentional.

issues.description: A category filter chip on the far right of the chip row is cut off with no visible label, appearing as an empty sliver.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so partially visible chips still show part of their label, signaling horizontal scrollability more clearly.

issues.description: The last pizza card ('-20%') at the bottom is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar without any fade or padding, and its title/details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards aren't hard-clipped behind the nav bar, or ensure the card's metadata is reachable on scroll.
